SMTO-HTTP-0021 — SMTO couldn't find the saved web service connection

GUID: 022aabdf-1507-400d-ac9d-fa5212a085ab
Slug: http-profile-not-found
Domain: HTTP · Subsystem: http

What happened

  • SMTO looked for a saved web service connection with the name it was given, but no saved connection has that name. Nothing was sent to the service.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Open Parameter Store and search for the connection. If it exists, note its exact name and tell SMTO in the conversation to use that name. The connection may exist under a different name than the one SMTO tried.
  2. If it doesn't exist, choose an HTTP template (such as HTTP Connection) from the New parameter template list, select New, fill in Base URL and Authentication, then select Save. SMTO can only use connections that have been saved in Parameter Store.
  3. Select Test connection, then ask SMTO to continue using the connection's exact name. Testing first confirms the new connection works before the task relies on it.

What success looks like

  • SMTO connects using the named connection and continues without this message.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. For a task that was already running, don't point it at a different connection without checking with them first.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • The Parameter Store lookup found no record for the supplied HTTP profile key.

What this means

  • Parameter Store lookup found no record for the supplied profile selector. The specific receipt owns dispatch and effect truth. Authentication exchanges, resource requests and Gateway admission are separate phases; rendering this explanation performs no request and never authorizes replay of an uncertain mutation.

Why this can happen

  • Parameter Store lookup found no record for the supplied profile selector.

How to diagnose it

  • Check the currently available profile listing and intended key before creating anything.

How to fix it

  • exact_record and HttpRequestCapability._execute raise this when store.get(profile_key) returns no record. Select an existing exact profile key (http.inspect_connections or Parameter Store) or create the intended HTTP connection profile in Parameter Store; do not silently substitute a different profile for a saved run.
  • Select an existing exact profile key or create the intended typed HTTP profile in Parameter Store.

Retry and execution caution

  • Apply the correction and confirm the relevant state before requesting another attempt. Prior completed work remains governed by its receipts.

How to verify the fix

  • The exact intended typed HTTP profile exists and can be selected.

What not to do

  • Do not silently substitute a different target for a saved run or move its existing execution authority.

Technical notes

  • The specific receipt owns dispatch and effect truth. Authentication exchanges, resource requests and Gateway admission are separate phases; rendering this explanation performs no request and never authorizes replay of an uncertain mutation.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
